scope: UV topology, geometric correspondence, spacing, density and texel-center occupancy; not bake or runtime acceptance
warnings: 9814 triangles contain no texel center at this resolution; inspect thin receiver features before a bake

geometry.normalComparison: Normalized exported normals transformed by inverse transpose versus normalized frozen source normals

topology.policy: Join triangles only across the same source-space edge with matching endpoint UVs; exact coincident source positions bridge normal/color split IDs. UV seam comparison uses 1e-8 normalized quantization.

overlap.method: Spatial grid candidates followed by Sutherland-Hodgman triangle intersection; boundary-only contact has zero area

padding.method: Exact segment-to-segment distances between distinct chart boundaries, plus exact vertex-to-atlas-border distances. Half the inter-chart gap is available per chart; no nearby pair yields a conservative lower bound.

density.priorityDefinition: Same conservative near-lamp, below-lamp, source-normal-facing centroid bucket as source-metrics.mjs; not actual visibility or irradiance
density.limitation: Area density does not measure directional stretch, irradiance detail, or bake quality; eight texels per metre is an art target, not a UV transfer PASS condition

raster.method: Triangle scanlines at texel centers; half-open Y edges. This is coverage information, not a substitute for exact overlap/padding tests.
